core_obligations: Set up the framework lemma: its assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited locality lemma for local finite presentation (proof lines 1640-1645).

Choose a surjective \'etale chart U \to X; by the same locality lemma it suffices to show U \to Z is locally of finite presentation, and from f' locally of finite presentation plus Z' \times_Z U \'etale over Z' \times_Z X conclude Z' \times_Z U \to Z' is locally of finite presentation (proof lines 1647-1657).
Conclude U \to Z is locally of finite presentation by the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma applied to the covering {Z' \to Z} (proof lines 1657-1660).
proof_roadmap: Feed the locality assumptions into the framework lemma.
Move the property to the \'etale charts over Z and Z'.
Descend along the fpqc covering with the scheme-side lemma.
difficulty_reason: The proof is a two-step chart reduction through the framework lemma: its assumptions hold by the cited locality lemma; then for a surjective flat Z' \to Z of affines with f' locally of finite presentation, choose a surjective \'etale chart U \to X, transport local finite presentation to the scheme morphisms U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z' via the same locality lemma (using that Z' \times_Z U is \'etale over Z' \times_Z X), and descend U \to Z along the fpqc covering by the scheme-side Descent lemma. The double use of the \'etale-locality lemma and the final fpqc descent are the substance.
